title: 99 Planets To Defend / faction concepts
balance: Qualitative concept targets only. Basic role budgets guide tradeoffs; elemental resistance and abilities require separate testing. The fragile Void scout intentionally trades physical durability for resistance and teleportation. Complexity means handling demand. These profiles are not evidence of playtested balance.

factions.name: RainBOOM
factions.motto: Make a mess. Hold the line.
factions.identity: Cobalt mascot shapes, crown silhouettes and separate pigment chambers. Paint impacts form crisp ink-edged splashes.
factions.materials: Painted cobalt plastic, soft mascot fabric, rubber hoses, yellow and pink pigment tanks.

world.name: Odd World after hours
world.terrain: Amusement-park service roads wind between grassy knolls, flooded ride channels and oversized mascot buildings. A rollercoaster silhouettes the horizon. Keep open combat lanes beneath the colorful scenery.
world.play: Ride pylons provide cover. Paint channels create slow routes. Service bridges give long sightlines.
world.look: A sprawling deserted Roblox amusement park on rolling green hills at late afternoon, immense blue mascot head gate with gold crown, pastel separated paint reservoirs, orange rollercoaster weaving between cliffs, cracked service roads, blue river rides, chunky hedges, wide traversable foreground service-road junction and a small Worldheart beacon. No characters close to camera.

commanders.name: Blue
commanders.look: Blue from Rainbow Friends: large rounded cobalt body, gold crown, one X-button eye, other round white eye, crooked drooling smile. No armor.

active.name: Crown crash
active.effect: Slam the ground to knock enemies away from nearby allies.
active.limit: A long wind-up exposes Blue to ranged attacks.
active.cue: A crown-shaped yellow impact ring with heavy blue ink fragments.
active.window: Commit to a slam; long recovery

commanders.canon: Source character; game role and power are new crossover proposals.

commanders.name: Green
commanders.look: Green from Rainbow Friends: very tall thin green fuzzy body, extremely long flexible arms, googly eyes, open toothy mouth. No armor.

active.name: Color snare

active.cue: Two green outlined ribbons connect to a visible anchor.

commanders.canon: Source character; game role and power are new crossover proposals.

commanders.name: Orange
commanders.look: Orange from Rainbow Friends: small orange dinosaur-lizard with long toothy jaw, outward-facing eyes, stubby arms and tail, sprinting pose.

active.name: Feeding frenzy

units.name: Lookie courier
units.look: Original red round one-eyed Lookie-inspired helper with small cobalt pigment canister harness.
units.tradeoff: Very fragile; carrying pigment slows the courier.

units.name: Crown shieldcart

units.tradeoff: The rear and flanks remain exposed.
units.behavior: Project a short moving shield toward the nearest threat.

units.name: Hosehand
units.look: Original thin green mascot helper with two paint hoses, utility harness and broad rubber boots.
units.tradeoff: Little direct damage; hoses need clear line of sight.

towers.name: Pigment popper

towers.tradeoff: Low armor penetration and a visible flight time.

towers.name: Crown prism
towers.look: Tall gold crown-shaped reflector ring above a stout cobalt plinth, rotating separated colored glass prisms and narrow beam emitter.
towers.tradeoff: Needs time to focus and loses value against swarms.

weapons.name: Crown cleaver

active.name: Royal splash

active.name: Party pop

factions.name: Axiom
factions.identity: Pristine white ceramic shells, smoked glass and exposed graphite articulation. Twin optical lamps retain the familiar robot identity.
factions.materials: White ceramic, satin titanium, graphite joints, restrained ice-cyan status light. No gold or ochre armor.

world.name: The Equilibrium
world.terrain: White causeways cross black tidal water beneath monumental circular machines. Wild grasses colonize the seams. Clean silhouettes and deep water separate movement routes.
world.play: Narrow causeways create defense lanes. Circular plazas provide build space. Water establishes a clear boundary.
world.look: A pristine white robotic civilization on basalt islands, monumental ceramic rings and tiered white terraces across deep black-blue water, minimalist clean white towers with graphite seams, small natural reed patches in cracks, broad white traversable causeway in foreground, low sun and hard blue-gray shadows, tiny white service robots for scale, no busy cyberpunk city.

active.name: Equalize

active.limit: The back stays exposed; sustained fire exhausts the shield.
active.cue: Twin cyan brackets close into a white shield outline.

factions.name: Anomalous
factions.motto: Something is wrong with this patient.
factions.identity: The recognizable Animal Hospital patients, with their original animal bodies and unsettling faces. Our paint and ink change the rendering, not their anatomy. Commander roles below are proposals for this game, not named bosses claimed from Animal Hospital.
factions.materials: Pink, cream, cyan and indigo patient bodies; their exact eyes, teeth, ears and proportions remain identity anchors. Matte painted color, fine contour and non-gory shadow add depth without costumes or armor.

world.name: The endless night shift
world.terrain: A hospital campus stretches into pine-covered hills. Corridors open onto outdoor courtyards; asphalt ambulance roads return to doors that should not connect.
world.play: Lit doorways telegraph safe exits. Courtyards let players read threats. Impossible rooms are landmarks, not random navigation tricks.
world.look: Roblox animal hospital campus at blue-hour dusk, faded mint and cream low buildings, dark pine forest hills, crooked but traversable asphalt ambulance road and broad tiled courtyard in foreground, lit check-in windows, enormous distant hospital wing folded at one impossible right angle, red emergency lamps, clearly readable terrain, ominous but non-gory, no characters close to camera.

factions.name: Brainshot
factions.identity: Recognizable Brainrot characters first: a three-legged sneaker shark, a cappuccino-headed ballerina and a wooden bat-bearer. Preserve their bodies, faces and signature props. Painted-Anime-Inkline is a rendering treatment, not a costume redesign.
factions.materials: Coffee porcelain, sneaker rubber, varnished wood, pink fabric, blue enamel and exposed fasteners.

world.name: The impossible promenade
world.terrain: A seaside town collides with a coffee factory and oversized sports courts. Tiled plazas, surf-worn cliffs and absurd landmarks keep a grounded terrain layout.
world.play: Beach paths are fast but exposed. Cafe terraces create short flanks. The central factory is a defendable landmark.
world.look: A strange coastal Roblox town with Mediterranean painted walls, seaside promenade, wide warm stone plaza, oversized coffee cup factory with steam chimney, sneaker-shaped public pavilion, gentle blue surf, natural cliffs, basketball court on a terrace, absurd landmarks built as real architecture, sunny late afternoon, no text, no foreground characters.

factions.name: Robloxian
factions.identity: Classic block proportions, studded construction parts and recognizable avatar silhouettes. Warm plastic wears at handling edges; confident ink adds weight.

world.name: Crossroads, reimagined
world.terrain: A green central baseplate meets a stone bridge, brick towers and grassy stepped hills. Recognizable classic construction becomes a lived-in frontier.
world.play: The bridge is a natural defense lane. Brick ruins offer cover. Broad flat pads teach building without obstructing navigation.
world.look: Classic Roblox Crossroads inspired terrain reimagined in sophisticated Painted Inkline: rolling green studded baseplate hills, stone arched bridge across shallow stream, red brick watchtower, simple gray castle ruin, yellow construction crane, broad grass foreground building pads, bright soft cloud sky with painted contours, a tiny classic yellow-head blue-torso green-leg avatar for scale, no text.
